title: Digital Entity Awakening
description: A futuristic armored humanoid figure with glowing white eyes stands in the center of a dark, reflective chamber. The figure is composed of geometric crystalline panels and emits streams of glowing mathematical symbols, letters, and golden particles from its hands while the ceiling appears shattered with floating broken fragments above.
prompt: A tall humanoid figure made of dark geometric crystalline armor with glowing white eyes stands dramatically in a dark futuristic chamber with a highly reflective floor. The figure is releasing streams of glowing mathematical symbols, letters, and golden particles from its outstretched hands. The ceiling is shattered with floating broken fragments above. Mystical birds fly in the distant background. Cinematic lighting with spotlights, ethereal atmosphere, intricate details.
